summary: Toronto, Ontario, medical device industry professional, experience in software development and scientific software, expertise in image processing and signal processing, background in medical imaging and MRI physics, interest in neurosurgery applications, familiarity with ISO standards (ISO 13485, IEC 60601), strong technical background in C++ and numerical coding techniques, engaged in R&D roles, advocates for high-performance computing and data streaming, values evidence-based practices in healthcare, critical of simplistic views on technology and policy, emphasizes the importance of understanding underlying principles in software engineering, active in discussions about the intersection of technology and healthcare.
